content_zh:
吴怡洁冷若冰霜，这个世界已经够悲惨，要是再留不住小薇，钟晓飞的生活就没有一点的乐趣了！想到吴怡洁，钟晓飞发现自己有点神魂颠倒了，只要一有空闲，他脑子里面就会闪现吴怡洁的影子，哎，这可真是要命，吴怡洁明明就是一个只能看，却永远也摘不到的星星，可他就是无法抑制内心的冲动。

他觉得，他迟早要“死”在吴怡洁的手里。

这时，徐佳佳扭头看见了钟晓飞，朝钟晓飞眨眨眼，然后轻笑着跟小薇咬耳朵，小薇转头看见了钟晓飞，“姐夫！”摇手雀跃的喊。从她兴奋的表情看，她的心情一点没有受到影响，嗯，看起来徐佳佳真没有跟她说。

和上午去公司面试不同，小薇换了一身衣服，穿着一件短袖的t恤和牛仔的小短裤，钟晓飞的眼睛偷偷在她**的嫩腿上溜了一圈，然后心里再一次的赞叹，啊！小薇的两条嫩腿比新鲜的莲藕还要白、还要嫩，充满了健康的活力，的的确确是极品啊。

“姐夫，你怎么才来，我们等你好久了！”小薇撅着小嘴娇嗔。

钟晓飞先心虚的看了徐佳佳一眼，然后尴尬的笑，“路上车多……”

“是车多还是怕付账啊？”徐佳佳是笑非笑，“钟大官人，你撒谎也不找一个好借口啊？”

虽然钟晓飞叫徐佳佳女汉子，但其实徐佳佳也是一个大美女，一米六七的身材，雪白的肌肤，俏丽的脸蛋，一头齐肩的碎发让她看起来很清爽，与吴怡洁、李小薇不同，徐佳佳的身材属于是苗条型，虽然胸不大，但前凸后翘的很明显。在大学时代，她是学校的校花，追求者如云，不过徐佳佳一直没有正式的处过男朋友。钟晓飞笑她是一名女汉子，对男人没兴趣，她也大咧咧的承认：女汉子有什么不好？自力更生不用靠男人。

在海州的这两年，钟晓飞和徐佳佳的关系一直没有改变，一直称兄道弟。

在外人看来，他们两个人是很般配的一对，有很多人想要撮合他们，但都没有成功。

“真车多，”钟晓飞正色的说，“疯婆子，你来也不提前打招呼，我好开车去接你。”

“少来！你有车吗？”徐佳佳翻白眼，“再说了，我也不是看你，我是看小薇妹子！鬼才愿意看你呢！”

看见钟晓飞徐佳佳两个人斗嘴，小薇先是惊讶了一下，然后抿着小嘴笑了。

“不用了，徐姐姐已经刷过了。”小薇笑着说。

“是吗？”钟晓飞装模作样的把信用卡又收了起来，其实这个结果他早有预料，徐佳佳最大的好处就是豪爽、大方，每一次和她在一起吃饭消费，钟晓飞很少掏腰包的，基本都是徐佳佳付账，照徐佳佳的话说，那些钱让钟晓飞留着娶老婆。

小薇买了两套小内衣小内裤，都是性感的蕾丝，钟晓飞忍不住吞了一口口水，心说小薇要是穿上这种蕾丝，估计能要人命。尤其是那条小内裤简直就是两片薄如蝉翼的丝绸，几乎透明，钟晓飞看了一眼就心跳加快。

对于小薇的尺寸，徐佳佳一劲的羡慕，“妹子，你小时候吃啥了，长这么大？”

小薇在徐佳佳的耳朵边小声说了一句什么，像是传授什么诀窍，徐佳佳咯咯的笑，“你呀，可比你姐姐厉害多了，咯咯……”

钟晓飞心里一动，眼前忽然浮现一张雪白俊俏，浅笑嫣然的脸，恍惚，有点岁月错觉的感觉，像是回到了大学的校园，她站在男生宿舍的门口等他，白色的长裙，长发飘飘，宛如仙子……那时的他和她，都是那么的纯洁，但现在他已经是百毒不侵的老油条了。

“钟大官人，想什么呢？赶紧走啊！”徐佳佳叫醒了钟晓飞。

“哦。”钟晓飞傻呵呵的跟在两个美女的身后离开商场，“唉，不知道李小冉现在过的怎么样？有没有男朋友？是不是偶尔也会想起我，就像我想起她一样？”走出商场，天色渐黑，路灯都已经亮起来，微微的有点刺眼，钟晓飞的精神竟然有点恍惚。关于过去的，他和李小冉的往事，忽然的在眼前浮现了很多……

从商场出来，三个人去吃饭。在商场附近的一家餐厅找了座位，小薇和徐佳佳两个人点菜，点完菜，小薇跟徐佳佳咬了一下耳朵，起身上厕所了。

“疯婆子，”小薇走了，钟晓飞有很多的话终于可以问了。“你今天几点来的？跟小薇说什么了吗？她知道我和她姐姐的事情了吗？”连珠炮一样的问，三个问题在钟晓飞的心里憋了很久了。

徐佳佳白了他一眼，“干什么？审问犯人啊？”

“我哪敢？我现在是犯人还差不多……”钟晓飞苦笑。

徐佳佳哼了一声，又狠狠的瞪了钟晓飞一眼，“你还没有告诉我，为什么要把真相瞒着小薇？”

“我说了你也不一定信……”钟晓飞的脸色悲伤起来。

“你快说，不要磨磨唧唧……”徐佳佳的脾气有点急，钟晓飞卖了两下关子，她有点不耐烦。

“好吧，”钟晓飞叹了一口气，“……你知道的，我和李小冉本来很好……”

“我知道，可你这个无情无义的家伙甩了人家……”徐佳佳冷冷的说。

“是的，所以我内心一直在谴责我自己，我觉得，都是我的错，是我伤害了她……原本一切都过去了，我想忘记的……但小薇的出现却让我意识到我是多么的罪大恶极！……原来，小冉一直都没有把和我分手的消息告诉她的家人，她一直都在维持这段感情……”

钟晓飞脸色痛苦，声音悲凉，他痛苦的表情把徐佳佳唬住了，徐佳佳睁大了眼睛看着他。

“我太对不起小冉了……我要赎罪，我要补偿！我不能让小薇知道实情，因为那样会伤害到她的姐姐！我要像照顾亲妹妹一样的照顾小薇，给她找一份好工作，让她在这个城市里生活，这样才能减轻我心的罪恶感……如果我做不到，我……我…………我一辈子都不会快乐的……”

钟晓飞低下头，声音甚至开始哽咽。

钟晓飞知道，自己的表演成功了。徐佳佳本就是一个刀子嘴，豆腐心的人。

“少来，你又骗我？”十几秒钟后，徐佳佳瞪着眼睛质问，不过声音却有点虚弱。

钟晓飞没有说话，只让自己的表情更痛苦。

他的话，有真有假，这样才具有说服力。要知道，徐佳佳也不是好骗的。

“唉，你要是不相信，就把实情告诉小薇吧，反正我已经伤害过她姐姐一次，再伤害一次也没什么……”钟晓飞两眼望天，一种悲伤至极的表情。

“好了，不要说了……”徐佳佳咬着嘴唇，狠狠的瞪着钟晓飞，“我就暂时的替你保密，哼，钟晓飞，你要是敢骗我，我，我……哼哼，我会让你死的很难看……”

钟晓飞心里狂喜，嘴里却悲伤的叹息，还摇头，“疯婆子，你为什么不相信我呢？”

“在你心里，我连鬼都不如吗？”钟晓飞苦笑。

“是的。”徐佳佳肯定的点头，“其实你就是一个鬼，一个说谎鬼！”

在和徐佳佳说话的时候，钟晓飞的眼角一直在看着餐厅卫生间的方向，因为他不想让小薇听见他和徐佳佳的谈话。

“好了疯婆子，我们别说这个了，说点轻松的……嗯，我昨天听到一个笑话，说在一个结婚典礼上，新娘子肚子有点不舒服，忽然放了一个屁，司仪机智的说：新娘放屁，大吉大利！”

“不想新娘子又放了一个，司仪笑笑：新娘子放俩，来年大发。宾客们掌声经久不息。”

“新娘子又放了一个，司仪脸色大变，说：大家敢快让路，新娘子要拉！”

处理了小薇的事情，钟晓飞轻松多了，开始发扬三寸不烂之舌，说起笑话来了，逗的徐佳佳前仰后合，哈哈大笑。

“徐姐笑什么呢，这么高兴？”小薇回来了。

“没……”徐佳佳笑的脸都红了，翻着白眼瞪钟晓飞。

小薇看了一眼钟晓飞，又看了一眼徐佳佳，灵动的眼睛转了几转，噘着小嘴埋怨，“姐夫，你跟徐姐姐这么好的朋友，你怎么没跟我说过啊？害的我刚开始不知道徐姐姐是谁，还以为是找错了人……”

“我还没有机会跟你说，”钟晓飞一本正经，“现在我郑重的宣布，疯婆子仗义，够哥们，是我最好的朋友，这世上除了我爹妈，她是最疼我的……”

“去你的！”徐佳佳白了他一眼，“鬼才疼你呢！当我是幼稚园的老师啊！”咯咯的笑了。

钟晓飞频频替她们两个人夹菜，脸上堆满了讨好的笑，虽然菜品不是很高级，但两个美女都吃得津津有味。小薇左一句徐姐姐、右一句徐姐姐，跟徐佳佳热情不得了。徐佳佳对小薇也很喜欢，两个人聊天，把钟晓飞晾在一边。钟晓飞看的暗暗感叹，心说小薇真是一个人精，跟谁的关系都这么好。席间有红酒，徐佳佳和小薇都喝了两杯，小薇喝的两腮绯红，样子娇媚欲滴。

从餐厅出来已经是晚上的八点多，钟晓飞打了一辆出租车，送徐佳佳上车。

“死人头，你可记住我的话，你要是敢对小薇妹子无礼，我就戳穿你的西洋镜，哼哼……”上车之前，徐佳佳在钟晓飞耳朵边恶狠狠的小声警告，右手还使劲的掐钟晓飞的手臂。

Wu Yijie is as cold as ice. The world is miserable enough. If Xiaowei can no longer be kept, Zhong Xiaofei's life will not be fun at all!Thinking of Wu Yijie, Zhong Xiaofei found that he was a little obsessed. Whenever he had free time, the shadow of Wu Yijie would flash in his mind. Oh, this is really terrible. Wu Yijie is obviously a star that can only be seen but never caught, but he just can't restrain the impulse in his heart.

He felt that he would "die" in Wu Yijie's hands sooner or later.

At this time, Xu Jiajia turned her head and saw Zhong Xiaofei, winked at Zhong Xiaofei, and then chuckled and bit her ear with Xiao Wei. Xiao Wei turned around and saw Zhong Xiaofei, "Brother-in-law!" she waved her hands and shouted happily.Judging from her excited expression, her mood was not affected at all. Well, it seemed that Xu Jiajia really didn't tell her.

Different from going to the company for an interview in the morning, Xiaowei changed her clothes, wearing a short-sleeved T-shirt and denim shorts. Zhong Xiaofei's eyes secretly glanced around her tender legs, and then he admired in his heart again, ah!Xiaowei's two tender legs are whiter and more tender than fresh lotus roots. They are full of healthy vitality. They are indeed the best.

"Brother-in-law, why did you come here? We have been waiting for you for a long time!" Xiaowei pouted her little mouth and said coquettishly.

Zhong Xiaofei glanced at Xu Jiajia guiltily, then smiled awkwardly, "There are many cars on the road..."

"Is it because there are too many cars or because you are afraid of paying the bill?" Xu Jiajia smiled half-heartedly, "Master Zhong, you can't find a good excuse for lying?"

Although Zhong Xiaofei calls Xu Jiajia a tomboy, in fact Xu Jiajia is also a great beauty. She is 1.67 meters tall, with snow-white skin, a pretty face, and shoulder-length hair that makes her look very refreshing. Unlike Wu Yijie and Li Xiaowei, Xu Jiajia's figure is slim. Although her breasts are not big, her bulges and backs are obvious.In college, she was the campus beauty of the school and had many suitors, but Xu Jiajia had never officially had a boyfriend.Zhong Xiaofei laughed at her for being a tomboy and not interested in men, and she admitted carelessly: What's wrong with being a tomboy?You don’t need to rely on men to be self-reliant.

During the two years in Haizhou, the relationship between Zhong Xiaofei and Xu Jiajia has not changed, and they have always called themselves brothers.

In the eyes of outsiders, the two of them are a very good match. Many people want to match them up, but they have failed.

"There are so many cars," Zhong Xiaofei said seriously, "Crazy woman, you didn't even say hello in advance when you came, so I could drive to pick you up."

"Come on! Do you have a car?" Xu Jiajia rolled her eyes, "Besides, I'm not looking at you, I'm looking at sister Xiaowei! Only a devil would want to look at you!"

Seeing Zhong Xiaofei and Xu Jiajia bickering, Xiaowei was surprised at first, then pursed her lips and smiled.

"No need, Sister Xu has already done it." Xiaowei said with a smile.

"Really?" Zhong Xiaofei pretended to collect the credit card again. In fact, he had expected this result. Xu Jiajia's biggest advantage is that she is generous and generous. Every time she eats and spends with her, Zhong Xiaofei rarely pays for it. Xu Jiajia basically pays the bill. According to Xu Jiajia, Zhong Xiaofei keeps the money to marry his wife.

Xiaowei bought two sets of small underwear and panties, both of which were sexy lace. Zhong Xiaofei couldn't help but swallowed a mouthful of saliva, thinking that if Xiaowei wore this kind of lace, it would probably kill someone.Especially those little underwear were just two pieces of silk as thin as cicada's wings, almost transparent. Zhong Xiaofei's heart beat faster after just one look at it.

Regarding Xiaowei's size, Xu Jiajia was full of envy, "Sister, what did you eat when you were a child to grow so big?"

Xiaowei whispered something in Xu Jiajia's ear, as if imparting some tips. Xu Jiajia giggled, "You are much better than your sister, giggle..."

Zhong Xiaofei's heart moved, and a snow-white and handsome face with a sweet smile suddenly appeared in front of his eyes. He was in a trance, a bit like an illusion of time, as if he had returned to the university campus. She was standing at the door of the boys' dormitory, waiting for him, with her white dress and long hair flowing, like a fairy... He and she were so pure at that time, but now he is an invulnerable old man.

"Master Zhong, what are you thinking about? Let's go quickly!" Xu Jiajia woke up Zhong Xiaofei.

"Oh." Zhong Xiaofei followed the two beauties out of the mall stupidly, "Hey, I wonder how Li Xiaoran is doing now? Does he have a boyfriend? Does he think of me occasionally, just like I think of her?" When he walked out of the mall, it was getting dark and the street lights were on. It was slightly dazzling, and Zhong Xiaofei was actually in a trance.Regarding the past, the past events between him and Li Xiaoran suddenly appeared in front of his eyes...

After coming out of the mall, the three of us went to eat.After finding a seat at a restaurant near the mall, Xiaowei and Xu Jiajia ordered. After ordering, Xiaowei and Xu Jiajia bit their ears and got up to go to the toilet.

"Crazy woman," Xiaowei left, and Zhong Xiaofei finally had a lot to ask."What time did you come today? What did you say to Xiaowei? Does she know about me and her sister?" He asked in a rapid-fire manner. Zhong Xiaofei had been holding these three questions in his heart for a long time.

Xu Jiajia rolled her eyes at him, "What are you doing? Interrogating the prisoner?"

"How dare I? I'm almost a prisoner now..." Zhong Xiaofei smiled bitterly.

Xu Jiajia snorted and glared at Zhong Xiaofei fiercely, "You haven't told me yet, why are you hiding the truth from Xiaowei?"

"You may not believe it even if I say it..." Zhong Xiaofei's face became sad.

"Say it quickly, don't whine..." Xu Jiajia's temper was a little impatient, and Zhong Xiaofei gave in twice, and she was a little impatient.

"Okay," Zhong Xiaofei sighed, "...you know, Li Xiaoran and I were very good..."

"I know, but you, a ruthless guy, dumped me..." Xu Jiajia said coldly.

"Yes, so I have been condemning myself in my heart. I feel that it is all my fault. It was me who hurt her... Originally everything has passed and I wanted to forget... But Xiaowei's appearance made me realize how guilty I was!... It turns out that Xiaoran has never told her family about her breakup with me, and she has been maintaining this relationship..."

Zhong Xiaofei's face was painful and his voice was sad. His painful expression frightened Xu Jiajia, who looked at him with wide eyes.

"I'm so sorry for Xiao Ran... I want to atone, I want to make amends! I can't let Xiao Wei know the truth, because that will hurt her sister! I want to take care of Xiao Wei like my own sister, find her a good job, and let her live in this city, so as to alleviate the guilt in my heart... If I can't do it, I... I... I will never be happy in my life..."

Zhong Xiaofei lowered his head and his voice even started to choke.

Zhong Xiaofei knew that his performance was successful.Xu Jiajia was originally a sharp-tongued person with a soft heart.

"Come on, are you lying to me again?" After more than ten seconds, Xu Jiajia asked with eyes wide open, but her voice was a little weak.

Zhong Xiaofei said nothing, which only made his expression more painful.

His words are both true and false, so that they are convincing.You know, Xu Jiajia is not easy to deceive.

"Well, if you don't believe it, just tell Xiaowei the truth. Anyway, I have hurt her sister once, and it doesn't matter if I hurt her again..." Zhong Xiaofei looked at the sky with an extremely sad expression.

"Okay, stop talking..." Xu Jiajia bit her lip and glared at Zhong Xiaofei, "I will keep it a secret for you for the time being. Hmph, Zhong Xiaofei, if you dare to lie to me, I, I... Hmph, I will make your death ugly..."

Zhong Xiaofei was ecstatic in his heart, but sighed sadly and shook his head, "Crazy woman, why don't you believe me?"

"In your heart, am I worse than a ghost?" Zhong Xiaofei smiled bitterly.

"Yes." Xu Jiajia nodded affirmatively, "Actually, you are just a ghost and a liar!"

While talking to Xu Jiajia, Zhong Xiaofei kept looking in the direction of the restaurant bathroom with his eyes because he didn't want Xiaowei to hear his conversation with Xu Jiajia.

"Okay crazy lady, let's stop talking about this and talk about something light-hearted... Well, I heard a joke yesterday. It was said that at a wedding ceremony, the bride was feeling a little uncomfortable in her stomach and suddenly farted. The emcee said wittily: Good luck to the bride if she farts!"

"I didn't expect the bride to let off another one. The emcee smiled and said: The bride lets off two and she will make a fortune in the coming year. The guests applauded for a long time."

"The bride released another one. The emcee's face changed drastically and he said: Everyone, please make way quickly. The bride will pull in!"

After dealing with Xiaowei's matter, Zhong Xiaofei felt much more relaxed and began to use his sharp tongue and tell jokes, which made Xu Jiajia laugh.

"What are you laughing at, Sister Xu? Are you so happy?" Xiaowei came back.

"No..." Xu Jiajia's face turned red when she smiled, and she rolled her eyes and glared at Zhong Xiaofei.

Xiaowei glanced at Zhong Xiaofei, then at Xu Jiajia, her smart eyes rolled a few times, and she pursed her lips and complained, "Brother-in-law, you and Sister Xu are such good friends, why didn't you tell me? I didn't know who Sister Xu was at first, and I thought I had found the wrong person..."

"I haven't had a chance to tell you yet," Zhong Xiaofei said seriously, "Now I solemnly declare that Madam is my best friend, and she is my best friend. Apart from my parents, she loves me the most..."

"Fuck you!" Xu Jiajia rolled her eyes at him, "It's the devil who loves you! Think of me as a kindergarten teacher!" she chuckled.

Zhong Xiaofei frequently picked up dishes for the two of them, with a flattering smile on his face. Although the dishes were not very high-end, the two beauties ate them with gusto.Xiaowei said Sister Xu to the left and Sister Xu to the right, and she was very enthusiastic with Xu Jiajia.Xu Jiajia also liked Xiaowei very much. The two chatted and left Zhong Xiaofei aside.Zhong Xiaofei watched and sighed secretly, thinking that Xiaowei is really a good person and has such a good relationship with everyone.There was red wine during the dinner, and Xu Jiajia and Xiao Wei both drank two glasses. Xiao Wei's cheeks turned red after drinking, and she looked charming.

It was already past eight o'clock in the evening when he came out of the restaurant. Zhong Xiaofei took a taxi and sent Xu Jiajia to the car.

"Dead head, please remember my words. If you dare to be rude to Miss Xiaowei, I will pierce your peep show, hum..." Before getting in the car, Xu Jiajia whispered a vicious warning in Zhong Xiaofei's ear, and pinched Zhong Xiaofei's arm with her right hand.
